instruction: Fix `group_by` in `datastore/query.py` so records that share a key are accumulated into a list. It currently overwrites the group each time, keeping only the last record per key.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/datastore/query.py b/datastore/query.py
--- a/datastore/query.py
+++ b/datastore/query.py
@@ -13,7 +13,7 @@
     groups = {}
     for record in records:
         k = key(record)
-        groups[k] = [record]
+        groups.setdefault(k, []).append(record)
     return groups
